## 3. Run 1 — the stop that occasioned Amendment 1

Run 1 (`a3f6a9c`) stopped at T2 on the original row 4: τ_exact − v1 proxy outside [−1, 61] s on 2,774 of 15,763 (17.6%). Its T1 took the largest-size {8, 15} print. Its artifacts are kept under `artifacts/run1/`. Amendment 1 re-specified T1 (A1.2) and row 4 (A1.1).

Run 2 (`518152c`) cleared rows 1 and 4, ran T3-T6 on the bipower instrument, and stopped at T6 on row 2: failed negative_excursion, positive_excursion, blindness. Its T4-T6 artifacts and charts are kept under `artifacts/run2/` and `charts/run2/` as the record of what the bipower instrument produced (A2.10); its A2 ladder, which stopped at the first failing rung, gave zero valid rungs on 27 of 49 dev events. Amendment 2 changed the noise scale to realised variance (A2.1), derived the control references by simulation (A2.2), added the peak tie rule (A2.3), judged every A2 rung on its own (A2.4), left the W ≥ L competition cells undefined (A2.5) and re-derived the halt flag (A2.6). T4, T5, T5b and T6 below are the Amendment 2 run; T1-T3 were not re-run.

## 13. Recorded, not acted on (A1.8)

Every earlier `move_at` (R0-T0c, v0, v1, v2, the exit overlay) used the minute-bar prior close, which differs from the revised close by a median of 36.2 bp (p95 372.6 bp) on this run. Those results are not re-run; their +30% membership and `move_at` carry this basis difference, whose direction on their findings has not been assessed.
